purpose: Run multiple independent terminalization-relevant computations in parallel, prioritizing gates that can be sharpened numerically without inventing missing source authority.

RQCP_CUTOFF_EXTRAPOLATION.goal: Test whether the observed high-cutoff plateau supports a stable numerical Ncut->infinity extrapolation for normalized fixed-band observables.
RQCP_CUTOFF_EXTRAPOLATION.guard: Finite-sequence extrapolation is not an infinite-cutoff theorem and does not establish the all-band autonomous gravity parent.

NONLOCAL_FINITE_DOMAIN_EFT_DISTINGUISHAB.goal: Quantify how well finite derivative Taylor comparators approximate the declared entire form factor exp(-z) on explicit finite momentum domains.
NONLOCAL_FINITE_DOMAIN_EFT_DISTINGUISHAB.guard: This is a functional-shape/domain audit, not a source-normalized graviton amplitude certificate or family terminalization.

HIGHER_DERIVATIVE_IHO_DQFT_BRANCH_ADMISS.goal: Machine-audit whether the post-Iter187 IHO/DQFT realization is explicitly represented in the five-branch quantization map and enumerate the exact family-scope gap if not.
HIGHER_DERIVATIVE_IHO_DQFT_BRANCH_ADMISS.guard: A branch-map reopen does not imply the branch is correct, sufficient, or terminal.

GLOBAL_COVERAGE_COHERENCE.goal: Recompute the current 15-row terminal/nonterminal denominator and prevent stale 14-row promotion logic.
GLOBAL_COVERAGE_COHERENCE.guard: Coverage bookkeeping alone never closes D2, D4, or D7.
